scripts.dev:admin: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project voicelet-admin-dev "concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,vite 'cross-env GATEWAY_MODE=simulated PERSISTENCE_PROVIDER=firestore FIRESTORE_PROJECT_ID=voicelet-admin-dev tsx watch src/main.ts' 'vite --config admin/vite.config.ts'"
scripts.test:persistence:integration: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project voicelet-test "pnpm vitest run --project integration --no-file-parallelism"
scripts.test:persistence:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project voicelet-test "pnpm vitest run --project e2e"
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:admin
scripts.test:worker: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.container:smoke: sh -c 'set -eu; docker build --tag voicelet:local .; docker run --rm --detach --name voicelet-smoke --publish 3000:3000 --env HOST=0.0.0.0 --env GATEWAY_MODE=simulated voicelet:local >/tmp/voicelet-smoke-container; trap "docker rm --force voicelet-smoke >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT; sleep 2; curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:3000/livez >/dev/null; curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:3000/readyz >/dev/null; curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:3000/metrics >/dev/null'
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
